sources.title: GitHub - IBM/gguf: IBM GGUF-encoded AI models and conversion scripts
sources.snippet: This repository provides an automated CI/CD process to convert, test and deploy IBM Granite models, in safetensor format, from the ibm-granite organization to IBM GGUF versions (with various supported quantizations) within model repositories respectively named with the -GGUF extension. These GGUF model repositories are also included to the Granite Quantized Model collection for convenience.

sources.title: Granite - IBM
sources.snippet: IBM Granite is a family of open, trusted AI models for business, offering efficient language, vision, speech and guardrail models you can customize and deploy.

sources.title: Granite 4.2 brings native reasoning to enterprise agents
sources.snippet: In enterprise workflows, tasks can be ambiguous and involve many steps to complete. An AI model must be able to follow complex instructions, retrieve the correct information, choose the right tools, act in the right sequence, and verify the result. Reasoning helps Granite 4.2 navigate this process more reliably.
